bounties.title: Bar videos
bounties.brief: Make the best fomo video at a bar on your campus, with the app in hand. The best one wins.
steps: Film it at a bar near campus
The app is part of the video.
bounties.check: 21+ · filmed at a bar near campus, fomo app in hand
rules: 21+ only. Film where you're allowed to, with the bar's okay and the okay of everyone on camera.
Drink responsibly. Nobody has to drink to be in your video.
Show the fomo app, but never show a balance or promise returns.
No purchase or deposit needed to enter. You can enter more than one video.
The fomo team picks the winner on creativity, energy and how fomo shows up, and emails them.
Entries may be edited and posted on @fomo.campus and fomo's other channels, with credit to your handle.
